thresholds.title: SOS timeout
thresholds.intro: How long each community waits for a crew to accept before the SOS is offered to the next team: backup teams in order, then the nearest free crews. Each time, the command center and admins are alarmed. Changes apply to the next SOS, never one in progress, and are logged.
thresholds.readOnly: Only a super admin can change thresholds.
thresholds.gatePhone: Gate security mobile (alerted on every SOS)

coverage.title: Coverage teams
coverage.intro: A team of crews and an ambulance covers communities, buildings and stand-alone homes. An SOS from a covered home rings its primary team first, topped up with the nearest other crews; if nobody accepts in time, its backup teams are offered in order.
coverage.name: Team name
coverage.empty: No teams yet. Create one, then add crews and assign places.
coverage.noCrews: No crew in this team yet.
coverage.noAmbulances: No ambulance in this team yet.
coverage.deactivateHint: An inactive team is not offered SOS first; its places fall back to the nearest crews.
coverage.backupsIntro: If the primary team does not accept within the community’s timeout, the SOS is offered to backup 1, then backup 2, and so on, one per timeout. Earlier offers stay open, so whoever accepts first gets the job. After the last backup, the nearest free crews are offered. Every change is logged.
coverage.needPrimary: This place has no primary team. Set one on the places page before adding backups.
coverage.maxBackups: A place can have at most {{max}} backup teams.

hospitals.title: Hospitals
hospitals.intro: Network hospitals that receive SOS patients. A hospital marked ER full is skipped when choosing; the hospital’s own staff can switch this in their portal. Every change is logged.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deskPhoneHint: When the app cannot reach our servers during an SOS, residents see “Call community desk”, which dials this number. Phones keep the last number they downloaded, so a change reaches them the next time they are online. Every change is logged.
settings.deskPhoneUnset: Not set: residents without a network cannot call the desk. Set it before going live.
settings.readOnly: Only a super admin can change this.
settings.commandCenterWarning: The community desk number is not set, so residents without a network cannot call the desk.
settings.languagesHint: English is always offered. Tick other languages to offer them in the resident and field apps once their translations are reviewed. Someone using a language that is switched off sees English. Phones pick up a change the next time they are online. Every change is logged.

specialties.title: Specialties
specialties.intro: What residents choose from when booking a consult. The symptom words suggest a specialty from what the resident types (comma-separated, per language).

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.intro: Doctors residents can book. Create the doctor’s sign-in first (staff:create --role doctor), then add their details here. Check the registration number on the medical council’s register before making them bookable.
doctors.feeHint: Leave a fee empty if that consult type is not offered.
doctors.verifyHint: Look up registration {{reg}} on the {{council}} register and check the name matches.
doctors.reverifyHint: Changing the registration number or council clears the verification and stops bookings.

consent.screenBody: You decide who sees your health information. You can change any of these later in Profile → Privacy.

care_record.title: Keep my health record
care_record.body: Store my readings, conditions, allergies, medicines and reports so the app can show them to me and provide the services I ask for. Nobody else sees them unless I allow it below or when booking.

emergency_share.title: Share my records with the hospital in an emergency
emergency_share.body: If I raise an SOS, send my blood group, allergies, conditions, medicines, last readings, emergency contacts and insurance to the receiving hospital through a secure link that expires. If this is off, only my blood group is sent.

family_sos_alert.title: Alert my family on every SOS
family_sos_alert.body: Tell my emergency contacts that an SOS was raised and when help is on the way. They never receive medical details.

proactive_care.title: Let the care team watch over my readings
proactive_care.body: The care team may review my readings and contact me if something looks wrong or a check-up is due. If this is off, I am never included in risk lists or alerts.

reminders.title: Medicine reminders
reminders.body: Remind me when a dose is due.

manager.title: Let {{name}} manage my care
manager.body: {{name}} can see my health record, book services and record readings for me. Everything they do is recorded, and I can remove them at any time.

doctor_share.title: Share with the doctor
doctor_share.body: The doctor sees only what I tick here, for this consult only.

whatsapp_updates.title: WhatsApp updates
whatsapp_updates.body: We'll also send booking and service updates on WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to stop them.

location.body: When you press SOS, your location goes to the ambulance crew and the community desk so they can reach you fast.
location.when: Your location is never tracked in the background. It is read once, at the moment you ask for help.
location.later: You can change this any time in your phone settings. Without it, help is sent to your home address.
